# B2 Command Line Tool

> The B2 Command Line Tool manages files and buckets in Backblaze B2 Cloud Storage.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/Backblaze/B2_Command_Line_Tool/blob/master/README.md): Learn about the command line tool.
- [Installation](https://github.com/Backblaze/B2_Command_Line_Tool/blob/master/README.md#installation): Install the tool.
- [Documentation](https://b2-command-line-tool.readthedocs.io/en/master/): Browse the command reference and guides.
- [Application keys](https://github.com/Backblaze/B2_Command_Line_Tool/blob/master/doc/source/quick_start.rst): Authorize with B2_APPLICATION_KEY_ID and B2_APPLICATION_KEY.
- [Account information](https://github.com/Backblaze/B2_Command_Line_Tool/blob/master/README.md#usage): Configure the account database with B2_ACCOUNT_INFO.
- [ApiVer](https://github.com/Backblaze/B2_Command_Line_Tool/blob/master/README.md#apiver-cli-versions-b2-vs-b2v3-b2v4-b2v5-etc): Choose between b2 and b2v5 for scripts.

## Guides

- [Scripting and agents](https://github.com/Backblaze/B2_Command_Line_Tool/blob/master/doc/source/scripting.rst): Check output formats, exit codes, and streams.
- [Authorization realms](https://github.com/Backblaze/B2_Command_Line_Tool/blob/master/doc/authorization_realm.md): Select an authorization environment.
- [Testing](https://github.com/Backblaze/B2_Command_Line_Tool/blob/master/doc/testing.md): Choose and run repository checks.
- [Writing style](https://github.com/Backblaze/B2_Command_Line_Tool/blob/master/doc/writing-style.md): Follow the documentation writing rules.
